Diagnostic serum testing, focused physiological assessment, and targeted structural evaluations demonstrate characteristic pathophysiological hallmarks of patent ductus arteriosus (pda) hemodynamically significant in preterm iv ibuprofen or paracetamol. Which of the following clinical actions best aligns with UAE national clinical practice standards?
